aws-news.headline: Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI is now in public preview and can run on AgentCore Runtime.
aws-news.note: AWS published no What's New items on Oct 3-4 (weekend). Items come from Oct 2 and the Oct 5 weekly roundup. No Mumbai or Hyderabad region news found.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI (public preview), plus GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5.5 on Bedrock
items.why: New managed agent option that runs on AgentCore Runtime in your account; compare it with your current agent stack.

items.title: Amazon ECS adds Amazon VPC Lattice support for blue/green, linear, and canary deployments
items.why: ECS services behind VPC Lattice get native traffic shifting and alarm-based rollback without CodeDeploy.

items.title: AgentCore Gateway supports private TLS certificates for VPC endpoints
items.why: AgentCore Gateway can reach private MCP and API targets with private-CA certs and no extra load balancer.

items.title: Amazon EKS and Amazon EKS Distro now support Kubernetes version 1.37
items.why: Plan cluster upgrades; 1.37 adds HPA scale-to-zero and better metrics APIs.

items.title: GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring is now included in the AWS Security Hub Threat Analytics plan
items.why: Billing change: Runtime Monitoring charges move into Security Hub; check cost reports and budgets.
